scientific_integrity: The all-graphs proof is by explicit simplicial collapses of the combinatorial Alexander dual, followed by integral Alexander duality and standard connectivity theorems. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite triangle-free graphs on at least eight vertices whose four-cycles are pairwise edge-disjoint. Graphs with triangles or overlapping squares and their equivariant representations are not classified. Finite checks are only examples.
title: Three-cut complexes of triangle-free graphs with edge-disjoint squares
